    s=['A']*58
    comp={'G':'C','C':'G','A':'U','U':'A'}
    for (i,j),b in zip(pairs2, stems):
        s[i]=b; s[j]=comp[b]
    # loops
    for k,p in enumerate([9,10,11,12]):
        s[p]=loop[k]
    for k,p in enumerate([24,25,26,27]):
        s[p]=loop[k]
    return ''.join(s)
